title: ID0405550-DC/Si-D/DK[tujg9j] - OperationMode "CLOSE_MAINBREAKER" --> "ERROR"
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
OperationMode stuck in Init
Root cause:
MCCB not closing due to design issue
Solution:
change QA29 command from FC14 to FC17
Future Solution
: Update to v7.0.X
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: ID0405550-DC/Si-D/DK[tujg9j] - OperationMode "CLOSE_MAINBREAKER" --> "ERROR" CRM:00315002331
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
I got an update today from R&D regarding this topic.
It seems that this fix is supposedly coming out in V7.0.X, let me know what you prefer, if you rather wait for the FW release or change the fuse as I mentioned.
This is also tested by R&D and confirmed. Here is a short note of their message:
solution 1:
TIA/IoT improvements
solution 2:
rewire the QA1 turn on trigger from FC14 to FC17
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0405550-DC/Si-D/DK[tujg9j] - OperationMode "CLOSE_MAINBREAKER" --> "ERROR" CRM:00315002331
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
Thanks for the feedback.
There must be no cause of concern if you leave it like that until the next visit. The only change in software is a
delay in PLC software of 50ms for the command.
For now, I have provided all the information that I can. Next step is to wait for the v7.0.X firmware, test and confirm that it works without the change of fuses. Or if you wish to leave it like that, that's fine by me, we just need to write down in SCB that there is this change.
Since the issue has been resolved can I close the ticket?
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
